chapters.content:
The Love Hypothesis is a contemporary work by Ali Hazelwood (2021).

Third-year Ph.D. candidate Olive Smith kisses the first man she sees in a panic—who happens to be unyielding professor Adam Carlsen.

Categorized under: Romance, Contemporary, Romantic Comedy.
